ranks: Curses: Auras that enchant a player (rule 303.4), "whenever enchanted player is attacked" with "each opponent attacking that player does the same", and "a creature enchanted player controls" (mechanic:curses)

blocked.name: Tenuous Truce
blocked.why: Enchant opponent works now, but 'when you attack enchanted opponent or a planeswalker they control or when they attack you or a planeswalker you control' needs an attack trigger that counts planeswalkers and runs both ways; attacks-player counts players only.

blocked.name: Fraying Sanity
blocked.why: Enchant player works now; X is the number of cards put into the enchanted player's graveyard from anywhere this turn, which no turn stat counts.

blocked.name: Grievous Wound
blocked.why: 'Enchanted player can't gain life' is a static over the enchanted player (no affects scope reaches a player), and 'whenever enchanted player is dealt damage' needs a dealt-damage trigger keyed to the enchanted player.

blocked.name: Paradox Haze
blocked.why: Enchant player works now; 'at the beginning of enchanted player's first upkeep each turn, that player gets an additional upkeep step' needs an added upkeep for another player's turn.

blocked.name: Curse of the Restless Dead
blocked.why: Enchant player works now; its Zombie tokens have decayed.

blocked.name: Maddening Hex
blocked.why: A d6 roll, and reattaching the Curse to a random other opponent.

blocked.name: Ardenn, Intrepid Archaeologist
blocked.why: Attaching any number of Auras and Equipment to a target permanent or player: attach doesn't take a player.
